summary: Our project is an interactive educational game that helps students learn about space missions and the challenges astronauts face. Players experience the role of an astronaut and make decisions to keep their mission safe and successful. The game teaches students about important resources such as oxygen, water, and energy, and how to deal with space challenges like solar storms. We created this project to make learning about space fun, simple, and interesting. It helps students improve their problem-solving and decision-making skills while discovering more about space exploration. Our goal is to inspire young learners to become future space explorers and scientists.
details: Our project, NASA Heroes, is an educational space adventure game developed using Microsoft MakeCode Arcade. It helps students learn about space missions and the challenges astronauts may face. Players take on the role of astronauts and make decisions during their missions. The project aims to improve problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills. We chose an interactive game because it makes learning about space more enjoyable and easier to understand. We used coding and game design to create an educational experience that inspires students to explore space and learn more about science and technology.
